target_name: Verify Ozone Through Ozone as a Third Party
source_quotes: we should not be building a mock farm; test on VPS as well or at least here first
overlap_check: Extends draft 13 with the no-mocks rule and the edit-only phase rule. Built-in method_49 (test the real substrate, skips are not passes) is closely related; at review this could point there.

add_heuristics.condition: an external system cannot run here
add_heuristics.action: find a way to run the real thing, such as a user-space install, or ask for the EU

add_decision_rules.name: A mock is not evidence
add_decision_rules.condition: an external system cannot be run
add_decision_rules.outcome: run the real thing or ask for the operator's second host; label anything mock-based as a regression guard only

add_decision_rules.name: Edit-only phases
add_decision_rules.condition: the operator locks builds and tests
add_decision_rules.outcome: review by reading, capture every edit, correct earlier claims explicitly, and build or test nothing until the lock is lifted

add_decision_rules.name: Every entry point as a third party
add_decision_rules.outcome: cover the command line, the UI, the MCP surface and the tool routes separately, each with its own credential
